summary: Removing the worn levitation ring while standing on lava has two source-traced JS defects. C do_wear.c:doremring -> Ring_off -> Ring_off_or_gone calls trap.c:float_down, which immediately invokes lava_effects when the hero has landed on lava and is not already inside lava_effects; JS float_down instead records note_unported('trap.c lava_effects') and defers those effects to hack.js:pooleffects, so the first RNG call at step 32 differs. Once invoked at the C call site, JS lava_effects must also remove an inventory cloak marked in_use before useupall; its conservative W_ARMOR guard skips the existing supported cloak-removal path, leaving stale worn state. The implementation scope is a divergence fix in trap.c:float_down/lava_effects behavior, limited to immediate source-order execution and the existing W_ARMC removal path.

source.branch: After float_down clears the last levitation source, when no blocked-levitation or flight/swallow early return applies, the hero is on lava and iflags.in_lava_effects is zero, C calls lava_effects immediately and sets no_msg true. In lava_effects, for a vulnerable hero whose worn cloak was flagged in_use, C invokes remove_worn_item before useupall so cloak slot and worn mask state are cleared before destruction.
dependencies: steal.c:remove_worn_item; existing js/steal.js W_ARMOR branch dispatches the worn cloak to Cloak_off
hack.c:pooleffects remains the independent end-of-turn lava-effects caller

evidence: Saved combined queue entry at .cache/latest-saved-combined-queue.json (SHA-256 781129791f95cd10ec8578dd170fd5298182a9b4ad578f5c008d93d68d5bc37b) identifies the admitted v39 case, 12 remaining screens, and the first mismatch at segment 0 step 32, key R: C d(6,6)=22 from lava_effects(trap.c:6800), versus JS rn2(5)=2.

Fresh differential at /tmp/teleport-validation-1000/run-iUYxqm reproduces the call-order mismatch at key R: C enters lava_effects during ring removal, while JS skips it in trap.js:float_down and later enters via hack.js:pooleffects. C trap.c:float_down lines 4107-4109 makes the discarded-return lava_effects call before its no_msg landing suppression; JS trap.js:2057-2061 currently records the gap instead.

C do_wear.c:doremring at lines 1874-1892 selects the ring and do_wear.c:Ring_off_or_gone at lines 1347-1447 clears its worn property before calling float_down(0L, 0L) for RIN_LEVITATION. This is the admitted recording's direct Ctrl-R removal route.

C trap.c:lava_effects marks vulnerable organic inventory with in_use before the fatal branch; its source calls remove_worn_item(obj, TRUE) before useupall. JS trap.js:1657-1678 currently rejects all W_ARMOR from the helper call, although js/steal.js:308-350 supports the cloak slot by calling Cloak_off. Replaying the current JS reaches a later stale-worn-state failure for the worn cloak (otyp 148) after the earlier RNG divergence.

No C source or do_wear/steal caller changes are needed: the root defect is in existing trap.js float_down call timing and the existing lava_effects W_ARMC dispatch guard. Focused source-pinned tests and a fresh v39 differential will validate the correction.
